Apple___Apple_scab.summary: Apple exhibiting symptoms characteristic of Apple scab. Timely cultural sanitation and targeted management are recommended.
symptoms: Visible foliar discoloration and apple scab lesions on leaf surface.
Localized chlorosis surrounding infection sites.
Potential premature leaf drop if untreated.

actions.text: Prune and destroy severely infected leaves; sanitize pruning shears with 70% alcohol.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; irrigate at soil base to reduce leaf wetness duration.
Apply recommended protectant fungicide or copper-based bactericide per local extension label.
Consider bio-control agents such as Bacillus subtilis or Trichoderma harzianum.

prevention: Practice crop rotation with non-host species for 2-3 years.
Ensure adequate plant spacing for canopy airflow.

sources.title: University of Agriculture Faisalabad / CABI Plantwise
Punjab Agriculture Department Advisory Service

actions.text: Prune and destroy severely infected leaves; sanitize pruning shears with 70% alcohol.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; irrigate at soil base to reduce leaf wetness duration.
Apply recommended protectant fungicide or copper-based bactericide per local extension label.
Consider bio-control agents such as Bacillus subtilis or Trichoderma harzianum.

prevention: Practice crop rotation with non-host species for 2-3 years.
Ensure adequate plant spacing for canopy airflow.
